definition: Slang for the buttocks, literally 'bread rolls'; used humorously or affectionately to refer to the butt cheeks.
notes: Derives from the visual resemblance of rounded bread rolls to buttock cheeks; widely used and not strongly offensive.

definition: Euphemism for the buttocks, literally 'fifth point'; a polite and humorous way to refer to the rear end without vulgarity.
notes: The 'fifth point' refers to the fifth contact point when sitting or landing after a fall — the buttocks. Very widely recognized across all registers including children's speech.

definition: The rear or backside; a common, mildly informal term for the buttocks.
notes: From the root meaning 'back/behind'; extremely common and only mildly marked; used freely in everyday speech.

definition: Diminutive of зад; affectionate or playful slang for the buttocks, often used in a flirtatious or fond register.
notes: The diminutive suffix -ок softens and sexualizes; commonly used in complimentary or teasing contexts about an attractive posterior.

definition: Anal sex; a loanword used as a noun or modifier to denote anal intercourse.
notes: Though source-categorized under 'anus (slang/crude)', in Russian usage 'анал' primarily denotes the sex act, not the anatomical structure (which is 'анус'). Borrowed from English/French.

definition: Humorous slang for the buttocks, literally the 'stern' of a ship; implies a large or prominent rear end.
notes: Nautical metaphor applied to the human rear; used humorously rather than crudely, often implying appreciable size.

definition: The pubic mound or mons pubis; a semi-clinical term also used colloquially to refer to the pubic region and pubic hair.
notes: Used in medical texts as a near-clinical term and colloquially by the general public; also extends metonymically to pubic hair (лобковые волосы).

definition: Pubic hair; the standard clinical and neutral Russian compound noun for hair in the pubic region.
notes: Fully neutral anatomical phrase; the clinical default for any medical, educational, or public health context.

definition: The perineum; the anatomical region of tissue between the genitals and the anus; standard clinical term.
notes: Primarily recognized by medical professionals and educated laypeople; rarely used outside clinical or anatomical discourse.

definition: Sexual intercourse; a formal legal and medical compound term for penetrative sex.
notes: The standard phrasing in Russian criminal law (e.g. rape statutes) and medical documentation; not used in everyday conversation.

definition: Coitus; a Latin-derived clinical term for sexual intercourse used in medical, sexological, and academic writing.
notes: International medical loanword from Latin; recognized mainly by educated or medically literate speakers; essentially never used colloquially.

definition: Copulation or sexual union; a formal and literary Russian term for sexual intercourse derived from 'to join together'.
notes: Used in literature, medical texts, and legal documents; sounds archaic or overly formal in everyday speech; more native-feeling than коитус.

definition: Sexual contact; a clinical and legal phrase denoting any form of sexual activity, broader than penetrative intercourse alone.
notes: Commonly appears in legal codes, medical consent forms, and public health materials; deliberately broad in scope.

definition: Sexual act or intercourse; the most commonly used formal-register phrase for sexual intercourse in Russian.
notes: The default euphemistic-clinical term that most Russian speakers reach for in public or semi-formal speech; appears universally in journalism, legal contexts, and polite conversation.

definition: Intimate closeness; a polite euphemism for sexual intercourse that foregrounds emotional and physical intimacy over the mechanical act.
notes: Common in media, counseling, and everyday polite speech; implies emotional connection as well as sex; the preferred phrasing when speakers wish to avoid both clinical and crude registers.

definition: Copulation; a highly technical Latin-derived term for sexual intercourse, used primarily in biology, zoology, and sexology.
notes: More technical and narrower in register than совокупление; appears in scientific literature describing both human and animal reproduction; vanishingly rare in everyday speech.

definition: To fuck; the primary mat-system verb for sexual intercourse in Russian, imperfective aspect, denoting ongoing or habitual action.
notes: One of the core roots of Russian mat (obscene profanity system); generates hundreds of derivatives and compound expletives; among the most taboo words in Russian; imperfective aspect implies repeated or continuous action.

definition: To fuck or screw; the most widely used non-mat crude verb for sexual intercourse, imperfective aspect.
notes: Does not belong to the formal mat system and is thus slightly less taboo than ёбать, but still considered crude; ubiquitous in colloquial speech. Primary etymology unclear — possibly from трах (crash/bang).

definition: To fuck or nail; slang verb for sexual intercourse derived from шпилька (hairpin/spike), evoking the image of penetration.
notes: Less widespread than трахать; the root implies a sharp pinning action; used in a mildly humorous or crude register, often in male-coded boastful speech.

definition: To fuck (perfective); the perfective aspect form of трахать, denoting a single completed act of sexual intercourse.
notes: Perfective aspect marks completion; used in past-tense narration or to denote a discrete, one-time sexual encounter as opposed to an ongoing activity.

definition: Fucking; a mat-system noun derived from ёбать, referring to sexual intercourse as an activity or the act itself.
notes: Part of the core Russian mat vocabulary; used both as a noun naming the sex act and as a general expletive amplifier; among the strongest obscenities in Russian.

definition: To have sex for a while; reflexive perfective of трахать, implying a mutually participatory and somewhat casual or extended sexual encounter.
notes: The по- prefix adds a sense of casual duration ('a bit'); the -ся reflexive emphasizes mutuality; slightly less crude in feel than the base form трахать due to the diminutive-casual tone of по-.

definition: To fuck aggressively; literally 'to tear off'; implies vigorous or forceful sexual intercourse with a dominant, conquest-oriented connotation.
notes: Derived from драть (to tear/flog/thrash); the от- prefix implies thoroughness and completion; strongly implies the active partner dominating the passive; can shade toward forceful or predatory framing.

definition: To fuck vigorously; literally 'to fry up thoroughly'; crude slang for intense sexual intercourse emphasizing heat, energy, and force.
notes: From жарить (to fry/grill/roast); the на- prefix implies thorough completion; evokes the heat and vigor of aggressive sex; less common than трахать or отодрать. Input romanization 'nazhirit'' appears to be a typo; correct form is 'nazharit''.

definition: To fuck; an imperfective variant of шпилить used interchangeably in crude slang for sexual intercourse.
notes: Variant form alongside шпилить; the -ять ending is a common imperfective aspect alternant; slightly less widespread than шпилить; both derive from шпилька (spike/pin).
